exec.commandLine:
set -eu

echo "========================================"
echo " Configurando ambiente Spark Connect"
echo "========================================"

VENV=/projects/.venv-spark

if [ ! -f "$VENV/bin/python" ]; then
  echo "Criando ambiente virtual Python..."
  /usr/bin/python3 -m venv "$VENV"
fi

echo "Instalando dependencias..."

"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install \
  pyspark==4.0.1 \
  pandas \
  pyarrow \
  grpcio \
  grpcio-status \
  zstandard

echo "========================================"
echo " Dependencias instaladas!"
echo "========================================"

"$VENV/bin/python" -c \
  "import pyspark; print('PySpark:', pyspark.__version__)"
exec.label: Install Spark Connect Dependencies

exec.commandLine:
python -c "
import os
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = (
    SparkSession.builder
    .remote(os.environ['SPARK_REMOTE'])
    .getOrCreate()
)

print('Spark Version:', spark.version)
print('Count:', spark.range(1000).count())

spark.stop()
"
exec.label: Test Spark Connect
Bootstrap AI Code Assistant

exec.commandLine:
if [ -z "${AI_BASE_URL:-}" ] || [ -z "${AI_MODEL:-}" ]; then
  echo "AI_BASE_URL and AI_MODEL must be configured."
  exit 1
fi

AUTH_HEADER=""

if [ -n "${AI_API_KEY:-}" ]; then
  AUTH_HEADER="Authorization: Bearer ${AI_API_KEY}"
fi

if [ -n "$AUTH_HEADER" ]; then
  curl -fsS \
    "${AI_BASE_URL%/}/chat/completions" \
    -H "$AUTH_HEADER" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{
      \"model\": \"${AI_MODEL}\",
      \"messages\": [
        {
          \"role\": \"user\",
          \"content\": \"Reply exactly with: AI connection OK\"
        }
      ],
      \"stream\": false,
      \"max_tokens\": 32
    }" | python3 -m json.tool
else
  curl -fsS \
    "${AI_BASE_URL%/}/chat/completions" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{
      \"model\": \"${AI_MODEL}\",
      \"messages\": [
        {
          \"role\": \"user\",
          \"content\": \"Reply exactly with: AI connection OK\"
        }
      ],
      \"stream\": false,
      \"max_tokens\": 32
    }" | python3 -m json.tool
fi
exec.label: Test AI Connection
